findings: Taiwan source mean and raw Pearson correlations lie within all predeclared tolerances across the complete fixed seed portfolio.
MACAD sex-specific medians are below the source in all draws by about 21% and 24%, much larger than seed variation, but below the 30% secondary review threshold.
Missing joint source covariates, family selection, ancestry, assay and repeated-measure differences prevent attributing the MACAD discrepancy solely to a generator coefficient.
Increasing the shared intercept to force MACAD median agreement would conflict with the primary Taiwan mean anchor; no supported population-specific correction is available.
No generator parameter was revised and no favorable seed was selected.
stopping_reason: Predeclared source retention conditions met; preserve visible systematic secondary discrepancy instead of fitting unsupported corrections.
